beats.text: Now the honest part. The code is **not** released. The paper says, upon acceptance.
The ablation baseline scores **seventy-nine**, which is below V M U Net. And there is no row for H C E M alone.
There are no seeds and no error bars, and the gains are **under one point**.
The abstract claims **efficiency**, but the paper prints no parameter count, no flops, and no speed.
So this is a promising **recipe**. It is not yet a **proof**.
